chapters.chapter_title: Physical Architecture of Diffractive Neural Layers: From Diffractive Lenses to Trainable Optical Networks

accepted_edits.original_text: By substituting electronic weight matrices with spatially varying phase profiles that modulate light via Fresnel or Fraunhofer diffraction, Diffractive Deep Neural Networks (D2NNs) fundamentally redefine computation.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Diffractive Deep Neural Networks (D2NNs) substitute electronic weight matrices with spatially varying phase profiles that modulate light via Fresnel or Fraunhofer diffraction, fundamentally redefining computation.
accepted_edits.reason: Remove weak 'By' opener; start directly with the subject to improve rhythm and authority.

accepted_edits.original_text: Single-plane diffractive optical elements (SPDOEs) enable compact imaging systems that overcome the space requirements of traditional multi-lens setups, yet their computational expressivity is fundamentally constrained by the physics of a single diffraction event.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: The computational expressivity of single-plane diffractive optical elements (SPDOEs) remains fundamentally constrained by the physics of a single diffraction event, despite their ability to enable compact imaging systems that overcome the space requirements of traditional multi-lens setups.
accepted_edits.reason: Shift focus from the enabling feature to the limiting mechanism that the paragraph develops; vary syntax from previous paragraphs.

accepted_edits.original_text: To realize the universal approximation capabilities of multi-layer cascades, physical implementation necessitates a mechanism for optimizing the phase profiles of individual layers.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Realizing the universal approximation capabilities of multi-layer cascades requires a physical mechanism for optimizing the phase profiles of individual layers.
accepted_edits.reason: Eliminate 'To realize' scaffold; use gerund subject for more direct, measured prose.

accepted_edits.original_text: Leveraging the trainable designs established previously, advanced architectural variants now exploit additional physical degrees of freedom to enhance computational density and functionality.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Advanced architectural variants exploit additional physical degrees of freedom to enhance computational density and functionality, building on the trainable designs established previously.
accepted_edits.reason: Avoid repeated 'Leveraging' opener found in global inventory; place context at end of sentence for better flow.

accepted_edits.original_text: Leveraging the ultra-low latency and parallelism established in prior sections, diffractive neural networks demonstrate unique utility in specialized imaging and security tasks where physical wave manipulation replaces digital post-processing.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Diffractive neural networks demonstrate unique utility in specialized imaging and security tasks where physical wave manipulation replaces digital post-processing, capitalizing on the ultra-low latency and parallelism established in prior sections.
accepted_edits.reason: Avoid second consecutive 'Leveraging' opener (also used in Para 5); prioritize the application domain as the entry point.

edit.original_text: These metasurface-based Diffractive Deep Neural Networks (D2NNs)
edit.reason: Term 'Diffractive Deep Neural Networks (D2NNs)' was already defined in Paragraph 1; remove redundant definition.
Acronym ODNNs is established in the article's abbreviation inventory; do not redefine with full form here.

chapters.chapter_title: Training Paradigms for Optical Diffractive Networks: Gradient-Based Learning, End-to-End Optimization, and Physics-Aware Algorithms

accepted_edits.original_text: The Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) framework builds on the differentiable training foundations established previously by leveraging these optimized physical structures to enable all-optical machine learning, where task-specific information processing occurs entirely through the modulation of coherent light fields across successive passive layers without electronic intermediate steps.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Diffractive Deep Neural Networks (D2NNs) leverage optimized physical structures to enable all-optical machine learning, performing task-specific information processing entirely through the modulation of coherent light fields across successive passive layers without electronic intermediate steps.
accepted_edits.reason: Eliminate repetitive 'builds on... established previously' scaffolding and redundant 'framework' noun; streamline to focus on the action of the networks.

accepted_edits.original_text: Despite the theoretical efficiency of all-optical inference, a significant simulation-to-reality gap often undermines on-chip schemes, particularly those based on metasurfaces where fabrication errors deviate physical performance from idealized numerical models.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: A significant simulation-to-reality gap often undermines on-chip schemes, particularly those based on metasurfaces where fabrication errors deviate physical performance from idealized numerical models despite the theoretical efficiency of all-optical inference.
accepted_edits.reason: Avoid starting with 'Despite' (overused in inventory) by moving the concession to the end of the sentence, placing the primary problem statement first.

accepted_edits.original_text: Physics-informed optimization strategies explicitly embed fabrication constraints and spectral dispersion directly into the loss landscape to ensure realizability, addressing the need to correct physical errors via hardware-in-the-loop methods.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Physics-informed optimization strategies explicitly embed fabrication constraints and spectral dispersion directly into the loss landscape to ensure realizability.
accepted_edits.reason: Remove the trailing clause 'addressing the need...' which redundantly summarizes the previous paragraph's topic (HIL) rather than advancing the current paragraph's specific focus on loss landscapes.

accepted_edits.original_text: Alternative training paradigms address the fundamental breakage of gradient chains caused by discrete device mappings, complementing physics-aware regularization that embeds fabrication constraints into the loss function.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Discrete device mappings cause a fundamental breakage of gradient chains that alternative training paradigms must address.
accepted_edits.reason: Replace the stock 'Alternative... address' opener with a direct statement of the problem (gradient breakage) to vary syntax and improve clarity.

accepted_edits.original_text: Advanced optimization paradigms now exploit specific physical degrees of freedom to create reconfigurable and multi-functional diffractive networks, moving beyond the resolution of fundamental differentiability breaks and non-idealities in training.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Specific physical degrees of freedom are now exploited to create reconfigurable and multi-functional diffractive networks, moving beyond the resolution of fundamental differentiability breaks and non-idealities in training.
accepted_edits.reason: Shift from active voice with generic subject ('Advanced optimization paradigms') to passive construction focusing on the 'degrees of freedom' to vary sentence structure.

accepted_edits.original_text: Leveraging the multiplexing capabilities of reconfigurable architectures, end-to-end differentiable training now scales to high-dimensional tasks that demand robustness against physical disorder and complex scene interpretation.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: End-to-end differentiable training now scales to high-dimensional tasks that demand robustness against physical disorder and complex scene interpretation by leveraging the multiplexing capabilities of reconfigurable architectures.
accepted_edits.reason: Remove the overused 'Leveraging' participle opener; restructure to place the main subject and verb at the beginning for stronger impact.

edit.original_text: Following the discussion of optical diffractive network applications in the preceding section, it is essential to revisit the foundational training paradigms that enable their physical realization.
edit.replacement_text: End-to-end differentiable training establishes the foundational mechanism for optimizing optical diffractive neural networks by treating physical light propagation as a computational graph amenable to gradient descent.
edit.reason: Remove generic transitional opener ('Following...') and start directly with the core mechanism defined in the second sentence to improve immediacy and vary rhythm.

chapters.chapter_title: Hardware Realization of Diffractive Neural Networks: Phase Modulation Platforms, Fabrication Techniques, and Reconfigurability Trade-offs

accepted_edits.original_text: Reconfigurable systems, such as Spatial Light Modulators (SLMs) and integrated rewritable metasurfaces, enable the dynamic task switching essential for flexible computing, even though static metasurfaces offer efficiency.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Dynamic task switching essential for flexible computing relies on reconfigurable systems like Spatial Light Modulators (SLMs) and integrated rewritable metasurfaces, contrasting with the fixed efficiency of static platforms.
accepted_edits.reason: Removes the weak 'even though' concession structure and varied syntax from previous paragraph openers; enters directly through the mechanism.

accepted_edits.original_text: Bridging the simulation-to-reality gap through physics-aware codesign is critical for the successful deployment of reconfigurable systems, which offer adaptability.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Physics-aware codesign bridges the simulation-to-reality gap critical for deploying reconfigurable systems that require adaptability.
accepted_edits.reason: Eliminates the gerund opener 'Bridging' and the redundant clause 'which offer adaptability'; creates a more direct subject-verb entry.

edit.original_text: Specific implementations include all-dielectric metasurface based diffractive neural networks designed to function as 1-bit adders, showcasing their utility in performing basic arithmetic operations optically.
edit.reason: Redundant repetition of the preceding sentence regarding 1-bit adders; adds no new citation or technical detail.

chapters.chapter_title: Wavelength Multiplexing and Spectral Bandwidth in Diffractive Optical Networks: Multi-Wavelength Computation and Chromatic Constraints

accepted_edits.original_text: Optical neural networks based on diffraction (ODNNs) operate as inherently dispersive systems in which the computational transfer function is strictly coupled to the illumination wavelength.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: In Optical neural networks based on diffraction (ODNNs), the computational transfer function is strictly coupled to the illumination wavelength, rendering them inherently dispersive systems.
accepted_edits.reason: Avoids the stock 'Subject + verb' opener and varies syntax from neighboring paragraphs while maintaining the physical focus.

accepted_edits.original_text: Physics-aware optimization establishes the structural blueprint for diffractive networks, yet enhancing their computational expressivity and robustness requires addressing inherent linearity constraints and environmental sensitivities.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Enhancing the computational expressivity and robustness of diffractive networks requires addressing inherent linearity constraints and environmental sensitivities beyond the structural blueprints provided by physics-aware optimization.
accepted_edits.reason: Removes the repetitive 'Physics-aware optimization...' opener found in the inventory and shifts focus immediately to the limitations being addressed.

edit.original_text: Wavelength division multiplexing has been utilized in 3D holographic imaging with diffractive deep neural networks to leverage chromatic dependence as a functional resource.

edit.reason: Repeats the mechanism described in the previous sentence regarding distinct wavelengths triggering independent operations.

edit.original_text: In the context of autonomous driving, all-optical segmentation via diffractive neural networks has been proposed to process RGB scenes directly without digital preprocessing, aiming to enhance latency and computational efficiency.

chapters.chapter_title: Bottlenecks and Future Trajectories for Diffractive Neural Networks: Toward Hybrid Electro-Optical Systems and Scalable Optical AI

accepted_edits.original_text: Current progress in transitioning laboratory prototypes to deployable optical AI is hindered by the intrinsic rigidity of static diffractive neural networks, which function as 'write-once' hardware incapable of dynamic adaptation without mechanical intervention or complete refabrication.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: The intrinsic rigidity of static diffractive neural networks, functioning as 'write-once' hardware incapable of dynamic adaptation without mechanical intervention or complete refabrication, hinders the transition of laboratory prototypes to deployable optical AI.
accepted_edits.reason: Removes the weak 'Current progress... is hindered by' scaffold and places the physical limitation (rigidity) at the start for stronger impact.

accepted_edits.original_text: A critical simulation-to-reality gap, defined as the performance degradation observed when models trained in idealized numerical environments encounter the noise and aberrations of actual hardware, hinders the transition from theoretical design to physical deployment in diffractive neural networks.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: The simulation-to-reality gap, defined as the performance degradation observed when models trained in idealized numerical environments encounter the noise and aberrations of actual hardware, obstructs the transition from theoretical design to physical deployment in diffractive neural networks.
accepted_edits.reason: Removes the filler phrase 'A critical' and replaces the generic verb 'hinders' with 'obstructs' to vary syntax from Paragraph 1 while maintaining the definition structure.

accepted_edits.original_text: Bridging the persistent simulation-to-reality gap requires optimization protocols to evolve from idealized numerical emulation to physics-aware training that embeds hardware constraints directly into the learning loop.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Optimization protocols must evolve from idealized numerical emulation to physics-aware training that embeds hardware constraints directly into the learning loop to bridge the persistent simulation-to-reality gap.
accepted_edits.reason: Eliminates the overused 'Bridging...' gerund opener identified in the style inventory, placing the subject (protocols) first.
